claim_boundary.primary_question: On the upstream Modded-NanoGPT near-Record-28 recipe, do Selective-none and Selective-diag improve validation loss relative to both Muon and the original Newton-Muon control?
claim_boundary.alignment_label: approximately 275M-parameter Modded-NanoGPT, near upstream Short Track Record #28
reasons_not_exact: the target host uses NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 rather than the upstream single-L40S hardware
the experiment adds Selective-none and Selective-diag to the two upstream controls
the experiment freezes seeds 2024 through 2027 and adds paired-seed statistical analysis
the derived trainers add provenance, local artifacts, checkpoint, and post-training W&B instrumentation
forbidden_uses: do not call this an exact Record #28 reproduction
do not use wall time, tokens/s, or steps/s from concurrent jobs as efficiency evidence
do not promote Selective-diag versus Selective-none to the primary comparison family
do not select methods, seeds, or hyperparameters after observing experiment-43 outcomes

pre_formal_integrity_amendment.trigger: The first run stopped during the seed-2026 smoke gate after original_newton_muon training because the c_proj state-kind audit reported an empty subset even though the aggregate K-state byte counts exactly contained the expected c_proj covariance and inverse storage.
pre_formal_integrity_amendment.root_cause: The upstream warmup rollback used optimizer.load_state_dict on custom optimizer metadata; under the pinned PyTorch runtime this transformed iterable string metadata such as the Newton-state kind label.
pre_formal_integrity_amendment.correction: Restore optimizer.state directly by preserved Parameter identity and require exact pre/post optimizer-state fingerprints before counted update zero.

upstream_reported_reference_only.use_policy: context-only; do not pool these values with experiment-43 seeds

roles.muon: upstream Muon baseline from train_gpt_muon_2.py; no Newton K state
roles.original_newton_muon: upstream Newton-Muon control from train_gpt_newton_muon_2.py; full K for attention and c_fc and four-block K for c_proj
roles.selective_none: same Newton-Muon recipe as the original control, with only c_proj K removed
roles.selective_diag: same Newton-Muon recipe as the original control, with only c_proj K replaced by four block-aligned diagonal scales

methods.only_allowed_algorithmic_difference: the c_proj contraction K representation among original_newton_muon, selective_none, and selective_diag

same_seed_requirements: identical model initialization fingerprint across all four methods
identical training and validation shard fingerprint
identical data-loader order and starting state
identical architecture and non-c_proj optimizer hyperparameters

pre_registered_seed_extension.rule: the analysis must justify the extension under the frozen ambiguity gate before either seed is run

certificate_requirements: resolved absolute path for every shard
file size and binary header audit
data_contract.formal_policy: all cells must use one accepted preflight data certificate

training_recipe.warmup_restore_policy: restore the exact pre-warmup model and optimizer states while preserving Parameter identities and arbitrary custom Newton-state metadata without optimizer.load_state_dict; verify model and optimizer fingerprints, then reset data loader, gradients, K accumulators, preconditioner step, and RNG before counted training
training_recipe.formal_checkpoint_policy: save and hash one model-only final checkpoint per completed formal cell, using canonical raw-model state_dict keys; it makes no optimizer-resume claim. Optimizer/K schemas are sealed separately in the numerical audit, and the checkpoint may remain on the remote host without entering the analysis handoff archive
training_recipe.resume_policy: never resume a partially trained cell; preserve it as a failed attempt and restart that cell from initialization

smoke_gate.purpose: cross the first Newton K refresh at counted update 16 and execute post-refresh updates
smoke_gate.schedule_policy: the 18 counted smoke updates use the exact formal 1695-update LR, momentum, and attention-window schedule prefix; shortening the smoke loop must not rescale any schedule

runtime_contract.actual_hostname_policy: the ephemeral container hostname is recorded in suite and cell manifests; the frozen execution identity is this host domain plus the accepted GPU, runtime, source, and data certificates
runtime_contract.pre_formal_host_amendment: changed from R1 host to the otherwise-idle LLaMA H100 host after read-only preflight and before any experiment-43 smoke or formal outcome; no method, seed, model, data order, hyperparameter, endpoint, or analysis rule changed
runtime_contract.data_path_resolution_policy: the nominal Newton-Muon-official-r0 data path may resolve to the shared Newton-Muon-official FineWeb directory only when the exact 51-file inventory, headers, and full preflight SHA certificate pass

training_runtime_gate.policy: the upstream-derived sources retain FlexAttention and torch.compile while leaving the optional compiled-autograd wrapper disabled

runtime_contract.controller_python_role: preflight, orchestration, analysis, and post-training W&B upload
runtime_contract.training_python_role: isolated torch/CUDA/Triton training only; W&B import is not required
runtime_contract.quality_parallelism_policy: quality cells may run concurrently on disjoint physical GPUs; all such timing is ineligible
runtime_contract.parallel_with_experiment_44: allowed only for quality runs with experiment 43 and 44 assigned disjoint physical GPUs and both honoring the shared physical-GPU locks

source_snapshot_and_recovery.bootstrap_policy: the live repository may only create and seal the first RUN_DIR source snapshot
snapshot_contents: all controller, worker, analyzer, source-builder, common, test, and contract files needed by the run
the recovery launcher, sealed outside the controller directory so snapshot-local tests and recovery never depend on later live-source drift
a complete file-hash manifest and environment certificate
source_snapshot_and_recovery.recovery_policy: recover the same RUN_DIR through its sealed snapshot; live-source drift is recorded but cannot block or alter recovery
source_snapshot_and_recovery.completed_cell_policy: reuse only a cell whose local integrity manifest passes
source_snapshot_and_recovery.incomplete_cell_policy: preserve the incomplete attempt and start a numbered retry from step zero

wandb_contract.upload_timing: after local training artifacts and checkpoint hashes are sealed
wandb_contract.upload_failure_policy: mark upload pending and provide upload-only recovery; never retrain a valid local cell because W&B failed

analysis_contract.difference_sign: candidate minus reference; negative favors the candidate
summary_requirements: sample standard deviation of paired differences
two-sided 95% paired t confidence interval with n=4 and df=3
